resources.string: System and per-app languages, read from Android itself. Mamori reports a change only after the platform confirms it.
The device-wide language list. Changing it affects every app that follows the system.
Read from the running configuration; this build exposes no LocaleManager list.
The system locale list is unavailable on this build.

Android has no public system-language API, so Mamori writes the platform\'s own system-locale store with “Modify system settings”, then checks the running configuration. Builds that only apply it at boot are reported as such.
“Modify system settings” is required for this. Grant it, then return to this screen.
No original language snapshot is saved yet, so there is nothing to restore.
The original language list is captured automatically before the first change. Without it, restoring would be a guess.
The system language list will be set back to %1$s. Apps that follow the system will switch too.
Every app that follows the system will switch to %1$s. The current language list is saved first so you can restore it.
The chosen language becomes the primary system locale; your existing fallbacks are kept.
Saved %1$s (%2$s). On this build Android applies it after a restart.
Overrides the language of this app only. Android stores it; Mamori does not keep a copy.
This Android version has no per-app language API, so the language cannot be set here.
Mamori follows the system language again
The change was not confirmed: expected %1$s, Android reports %2$s
Per-app overrides as Android stores them. Android only lets an app change its own language, so other apps are read-only here.
The system limited the installed-app query, so some apps are hidden.
No app matches this search or filter.
Reading another app\'s language needs Android 15.
Android reports other apps\' languages on this device.
Android blocked reading other apps\' languages here (READ_APP_SPECIFIC_LOCALES is signature-only). Their state stays unknown rather than guessed.
Other apps are read-only: Android has no public API to set another app\'s language, so Mamori opens that app\'s settings instead of faking a change.
Not readable on this Android version
Android accepts only the languages this app declares.
